nodes.label: Server Trust Separated From User Login
nodes.rationale: Establishing server trust does not log a user in; a password is never sent until the selected trust policy has authenticated the server certificate, so a MITM never receives a credential.

nodes.label: Pairing-Assisted TOFU
nodes.rationale: An out-of-band 160-bit one-time secret authenticates the first trust decision, so this is not plain TOFU. Domain-separated HMAC-SHA-256 proofs bind pairing ID, presented certificate fingerprint, and a fresh nonce in both directions, so a wrong code never consumes the record and a MITM presenting a different certificate cannot relay a matching proof. High-entropy text codes were chosen over short numeric codes to avoid offline guessing without shipping an unaudited PAKE.

nodes.label: Managed Exact Certificate Pin
nodes.rationale: MDM distributes the expected leaf SHA-256 fingerprint so unmanaged per-user administrator contact is unnecessary; import refuses silent replacement so an unexpected key change can never become trusted automatically.

nodes.label: Enterprise Private CA Trust Mode
nodes.rationale: A deployed CA bundle plus --server-name validation lets leaf certificates rotate without client re-pairing; CA modes deliberately never fall back to a pin or pairing when validation fails.

nodes.label: Trust-Policy TLS Preflight
nodes.rationale: Because an interactive password prompt can outlast a QUIC idle timeout, the CLI validates trust on a preflight connection, closes it, prompts, then opens a fresh connection and applies the same in-memory policy again before transmitting the credential.

nodes.label: Argon2id Password Storage
nodes.rationale: Salted PHC-format Argon2id hashes are verified in a globally bounded blocking worker pool so memory-hard hashing cannot block or exhaust the async network runtime.

nodes.label: Login and Pairing Rate Limits
nodes.rationale: Five failures per connection, 30 attempts per source IP per rolling minute, and at most four global Argon2 jobs. Pairing shares the same per-source limiter so an unauthenticated peer cannot probe pairing records faster than passwords. Distributed guessing and account lockout remain out of scope.

nodes.label: Server Identity State Directory
nodes.rationale: Mode 0700 directories / 0600 files; the daemon rejects symlinked, non-regular, wrongly owned, or group/other-accessible state and refuses to start when state and export directories overlap in either direction, which would expose the private key, password database, and pairing records to authenticated filesystem clients.

nodes.label: identity install Generation Rotation
nodes.rationale: Validated renewals are written as new private generations selected atomically via active-identity; old generations remain protected for administrative recovery.

nodes.label: Client Trust Database
nodes.rationale: Pins are keyed by server address plus server name; the client rejects symlinked, wrongly owned, or overly permissive trust state.
